selection_disclosure: The construction was selected after an exploratory finite linear-program search. The values below are not presented as preregistered confirmation. This lock freezes the deterministic witness and its exact pass/fail checks before the committed enumerator and independent auditor are run.
question: Can one-item clean-label audits identify the expected first-step clipped GRPO score-function update when the auditor observes the full group action vector and every per-item clean-label conditional law is held fixed?
scope: Exact finite synthetic identifiability witness. No model training, sampled model outputs, or capability claim.

policy.actions: Each member action a_i is sampled independently from Bernoulli(p), p=1/4.
policy.parameterization: A shared Bernoulli logit theta, so d log pi_theta(a_i)/d theta = a_i-p.
policy.reference: The old policy equals the current policy at the evaluated step.
policy.advantage: Population-standardized within-group binary clean rewards; set all advantages to zero when reward variance is zero.

clean_reward_law.all_other_action_vectors: In both worlds, independently flip each action bit with probability 1/5 to obtain its clean binary reward.
clean_reward_law.conditional_marginal_invariant: For every action vector a, member i, and world, P(y_i=a_i | a)=4/5 and P(y_i!=a_i | a)=1/5. Thus the one-audited-label observation law remains the same even when the complete action vector and selected member index are observed, including action-dependent audit selection.

audit_observation_models.item_only: Observe the full action vector a, chosen member index i (selection may depend on a but not on unaudited y), and the single clean label y_i.
audit_observation_models.group_atomic: Observe the full action and clean-label vectors (a,y) for a sampled group.

estimand.clipped_objective_relation: At theta=theta_old, each importance ratio is 1. For epsilon=0.2 this point is inside the clipping interval, so the local derivative of the standard clipped surrogate equals G.
primary_metrics: exact expected G in World A and World B
exact total variation distance between one-item observation laws
secondary_metrics: exact total variation distance between full-group observation laws
probability of the target action vector
conditional expected G for the target action vector in each world

frozen_decision_rule: The witness is verified only if exact enumeration gives identical full-context one-item laws (TV=0), distinct expected G values, and positive full-group observation TV. Any failed invariant rejects the construction. No statistical significance test is used because the declared outcome is a finite exact calculation.
limitations: The construction is an existence counterexample, not a prevalence estimate for real verifiers.
The group size is four and rewards are binary.
The environmental reward dependence on the full action vector is deliberately synthetic.
The expected gradient difference is not a measured optimizer step or task-success gain.
No method is proposed for an optimal audit allocation or correction.
The result does not establish novelty beyond related work on group-correlated verifier noise, finite-group GRPO bias, reward-gradient analysis, or correlation-aware auditing.
